servers.name: jupyter-mcp
servers.description: Jupyter MCP server for notebook-aware analysis, code execution, cell editing, and multi-notebook experimental workflows.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List files and directories exposed by the connected Jupyter server.

tools.name: list_kernels
tools.description: Inspect running and available kernels.

tools.name: connect_to_jupyter
tools.description: Connect dynamically to a Jupyter server without restarting the MCP server.

tools.name: use_notebook
tools.description: Open, create, or switch to a managed notebook.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.description: List notebooks and their active status.

tools.name: read_notebook
tools.description: Read notebook cells in brief or detailed form.

tools.name: read_cell
tools.description: Inspect the content, metadata, and outputs of one cell.

tools.name: insert_cell
tools.description: Insert a code or markdown cell into a notebook.

tools.name: overwrite_cell_source
tools.description: Replace the source code of an existing cell.

tools.name: execute_cell
tools.description: Execute a cell with timeout handling and rich output capture.

tools.name: insert_execute_code_cell
tools.description: Insert and immediately execute a new code cell.

tools.name: execute_code
tools.description: Run code directly in the kernel, including magic commands and shell commands.

servers.name: influxdb3
servers.description: InfluxDB 3 MCP server for sensor logging, time-series querying, schema inspection, and line-protocol writes.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check connectivity and health for the configured InfluxDB instance.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all available databases in the instance.

tools.name: create_database
tools.description: Create a new time-series database.

tools.name: execute_query
tools.description: Run SQL queries against a database and return results in multiple formats.

tools.name: get_measurements
tools.description: List measurements or tables in a database.

tools.name: get_measurement_schema
tools.description: Inspect columns and types for a measurement.

tools.name: write_line_protocol
tools.description: Write time-series observations using InfluxDB line protocol.

tools.name: load_database_context
tools.description: Load optional database context or documentation to improve downstream analysis.

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Retrieve built-in troubleshooting guidance for common InfluxDB operations.

servers.name: labarchives
servers.description: LabArchives MCP server for electronic lab notebooks, semantic notebook search, page reading, provenance-aware uploads, and project tracking.

tools.name: list_labarchives_notebooks
tools.description: List available lab notebooks.

tools.name: list_notebook_pages
tools.description: Traverse pages and folders inside a notebook.

tools.name: search_labarchives
tools.description: Run semantic search across indexed notebooks.

tools.name: read_notebook_page
tools.description: Read content from a specific notebook page.

tools.name: write_notebook_entry
tools.description: Write markdown, HTML, or plain text into a notebook page.

tools.name: upload_to_labarchives
tools.description: Upload files with provenance metadata as page text or attachments.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create and activate a project workspace for notebook-linked work.

tools.name: log_finding
tools.description: Append a finding to the active project context.

tools.name: get_related_pages
tools.description: Find linked or related pages from the project graph.

tools.name: trace_provenance
tools.description: Trace provenance metadata for a specific entry.

tools.name: sync_vector_index
tools.description: Build or refresh the semantic search index for notebooks.

servers.name: unit-converter
servers.description: Unit Converter MCP server for scientific unit conversion across temperature, pressure, power, density, energy, volume, and related quantities.

tools.name: list_supported_units
tools.description: List supported unit families and units.

tools.name: convert_temperature
tools.description: Convert temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit, and Kelvin.

tools.name: convert_length
tools.description: Convert length and distance units.

tools.name: convert_area
tools.description: Convert area units such as square meters and hectares.

tools.name: convert_mass
tools.description: Convert mass units such as kilograms, grams, pounds, and tonnes.

tools.name: convert_volume
tools.description: Convert volume units such as liters, cups, and gallons.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert between time units from seconds to years.

tools.name: convert_energy
tools.description: Convert energy units such as joules, kilowatt-hours, and calories.

tools.name: convert_pressure
tools.description: Convert pressure units such as pascals, bar, atmosphere, and psi.

tools.name: convert_power
tools.description: Convert power units such as watts and horsepower.

tools.name: convert_density
tools.description: Convert density units such as kg/L, g/cm^3, and mg/L.
